<subject>Healthcare Symposium Invitation</subject>
<body>
Clinique Innov Santé

Please find attached the official invitation for the upcoming Healthcare Innovations Symposium. A printed copy will be mailed shortly.

Dr. V. Kaminski  
Lumière Santé SAS  
BP 1188  
Saint-Priest, Lyon 69800  

Clinique Innov Santé

11 March 2025

I am pleased to formally invite you to attend, contribute, and present at the Regional Healthcare Innovations Symposium hosted by Lumière Santé. Each invited speaker will have thirty minutes for their presentation, followed by approximately ten minutes for discussion. This symposium, supported by a grant from Santé Futur Foundation to Lumière Santé, will not follow the usual format of medical conferences where industry, academia, and public health officials share recent research. Instead, the focus will be on practical healthcare technologies and solutions currently implemented in clinical practice and hospital operations. Moreover, the event aims to highlight the platforms and partnerships that foster collaboration between healthcare providers, research institutions, and regulatory bodies.

The symposium will take place at Clinique Saint-Augustin from 25 to 28 April. Lumière Santé’s Clinical Operations unit will cover travel expenses as well as accommodation and meals for invited presenters. We would be glad to assist with travel bookings if needed.

We hope you will be able to join us. Should you accept this invitation, please send us your presentation title, a brief summary, and any technical requirements for your talk.

Looking forward to welcoming you at Saint-Augustin.

Best regards,

Christophe Rivière  
Specialist  
Lumière Santé SAS  
+33 4 78 00 12 34  
12 rue des Lumières  
69003 Lyon  
France
